## PRODUCT_SENSE.md + docs/product-specs/
**Read when:** Choosing between Argus, Metis, or Hermes feature scope; resolving tradeoffs between shared infrastructure and product-specific UX.
**Skip when:** Working on a single-product subsystem whose contract is already fixed.
**Status:** pending

## DESIGN.md + docs/design-docs/
**Read when:** Selecting data models, pipeline stage boundaries, or deciding whether a component belongs in shared core or a product-specific agent.
**Skip when:** Refactoring within an existing stage whose input/output contracts are unchanged.
**Status:** pending

## ARCHITECTURE.md + tools/lint/
**Read when:** Adding a new pipeline stage, changing import-linter rules, or modifying layer boundaries (CLI → agents → core → models).
**Skip when:** Editing a single file within its existing layer without changing public interfaces.
**Status:** pending

## QUALITY_SCORE.md
**Read when:** Prioritizing test coverage gaps, evaluating whether a refactor improves or regresses observable quality.
**Skip when:** Making trivial fixes with no behavioral change.
**Status:** pending
